senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בל , v. בלל) to absorb, opp. פלט; to swallow, consume.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:1:8">Y. Shek. VI, 49ᶜ</cite> bot.… <he>שהאור בּוֹלֵעַ בּוֹלַעַת … בּוֹלְעִין</he> the flame absorbs a portion of the oil, and so do the wood and the kettle.
<cite ref="Chullin 110b">Ḥull. 110ᵇ</cite> the liver when boiled with other meat <he>פולטת ואינה ב׳</he> gives out (blood) but absorbs nothing from the other pieces.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:4:5">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᵈ</cite> top; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:3">Tosef. Sabb. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:9">XIII</cite>), 9 but he may sip vinegar <he>ובוֹלֵעַ</he> and swallow it (opp. <he>פלט</he> to spit it out).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:1:11">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הלעוס כבָלוּעַ</he> what is chewed is to be considered as swallowed.
<cite ref="Chullin 71a:23">Ḥull. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>טומאה בְלוּעָה</he> an unclean object (food) that has been swallowed.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a:14">Snh. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>הַבְּלוּעִין</he> those (of the band of Korah) that were swallowed up.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 9:6">Kel. IX, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="D01033"><he>דָּֽרְבָן</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be swallowed; with בין, to be absorbed, disappear.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 36b:16">Sot. 36ᵇ</cite>; Tanḥ. Vayigg. 4; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 150:1">Yalk. Gen. 150</cite> (interpret. the name Bela, <cite ref="Genesis 46:21">Gen. XLVI, 21</cite>) <he>שנ׳ בין האומות</he> for he (Joseph) has disappeared among gentiles.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94:8">Gen. R. s. 94</cite>; Yalk. l. c. <he>שנבלע ממני</he> he disappeared to me.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 33">Ex. R. s. 33</cite> <he>הִבְלַעְתָּ לקרה</he> thou mad’st (the earth) swallow Korah.
<cite ref="Berakhot 24b:6">Ber. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>מַבְלִיעוֹ בטליתו</he> he hides the spittle in his cloak; Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵇ top.
Ḥull. 113ᵃ מַבְ׳ דם באברים causes the blood to remain in the meat (prevents it from flowing out).—Trnsf. to sell something in connection with other things, in a lump, in the bargain.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 31b:12">Bekh. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>מבליעו וכ׳</he> he sells it (the meat) in the bargain with the hide &c.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 64a">B. Mets. 64ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 118b">B. Kam. 118ᵇ</cite> one who robs his neighbor <he>וה׳ לו בחשבון</he> and makes up for it implicitly on settling his accounts. V. <cite ref="E00046"><he>הַבְלָעָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be swallowed up; to mingle with, v. supra Nif.—Part. מוּבְלַע.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 31b:17">Ber. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ בין אנשים</he> mixing with people, expl. <he>לא ארוך וכ׳</he> neither very tall &c. (of average qualities).

Erub. IV, 6 מ׳ ביניהן his property is enclosed between theirs (reaches into the limits of each). Y. ib. IV, 21ᵈ bot. עיירות המוּבְלָעוֹת inland-towns, opp. border-towns. Y. B. Bath. VII, 15ᶜᵈ מוּבְלָעִין בה fields which are enclosed by others belonging to the same estate.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 19">Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX</cite>, beg. <he>מִתְבַּלֵּעַ מן וכ׳</he> he disappears from the world (forfeits his life).
